webflow-blue.$description: Webflow Blue — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

indigo-ink.$description: Indigo Ink — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

mercury-tint.$description: Mercury Tint — Soft blue for icon decorations, gradient transitions, and muted highlight washes within illustrations

mint-pulse.$description: Mint Pulse — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

apricot-glow.$description: Apricot Glow — Decorative warm accent in inline illustrations and product mockup contexts

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, headings, icon strokes, dark surface fills — the near-black that carries the typographic voice

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills, inverted text

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary body text, icon secondary state, muted descriptions, footer copy

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Hairline borders on cards, dividers, input outlines, button strokes

smoke.$description: Smoke — Subtle shadow base and disabled control fills

graphite.$description: Graphite — Dark surface for inverted sections and modal overlays

onyx.$description: Onyx — Deepest dark surface — footer bands and full-bleed dark sections

mist.$description: Mist — Subtle background tint for alternating sections, card hover, and input fills

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Near-black accent surface, slightly lighter than Onyx for layered dark contexts

wf-visual-sans-variable.$description: The sole sans family for the entire interface — navigation, body, headings, buttons, cards. A custom geometric variable typeface with widths that compress at display sizes. Weight 400 covers body and UI; 500–550 for subheads and labels; 600 reserved for the boldest display headlines. The variable axis enables optical sizing so display weights (56–80px) feel chiseled with tight tracking while body weights (14–16px) remain open and readable.

wf-visual-sans-mono.$description: Monospaced companion for code snippets, terminal outputs, keyboard shortcuts, and developer-facing micro-copy. Rare on the marketing site but present in product demos.
